title: WL-MT409-WpLocalStoreDiagnosticsArgusAndManual
clause: Expose explicit non-authority status, health, promotion, recovery and archive diagnostics through quiet operator, Argus and no-context model surfaces.

conditional_execution.approved: Execute this contract normally after MT-408.
conditional_execution.rejected: Execute only the no-code rejection branch: verify MT-402..408 dispositions and emit an existing-governance hsk.wp_local_store_rejection_projection@1 record for MT-410. Do not edit product code, add a UI surface, add a dependency or create local state.

surfaces: Promotion, recovery, archive and evaluation detail views

scope.summary: GOAL: Make the conditional WpLocalStore understandable and operable without hidden context. A stable backend diagnostic snapshot and read-only operator panel must label the store LOCAL_NON_AUTHORITY and show exact project/WP identity, lifecycle, broker generation, provider/format/schema, encryption readiness, quotas, intent states, canonical watermark, last independent receipt, recovery/archive state and bounded repair actions. Every view must distinguish local candidate evidence from canonical SurrealDB/EventLedger truth. Argus and the built-in model manual receive deterministic targets, schemas, failure meanings and recovery commands; background diagnostics remain quiet and never expose content, secrets or absolute paths.
forbidden_paths: Any status label implying WpLocalStore is primary, canonical, synchronized truth or adopted by default
Raw SQL console, direct database file opener or provider-specific control in the operator UI
Displaying Notes/Loom/CKC/Tailor/Studio/Locus content, encryption keys, credentials or machine-absolute paths
Repair actions that reset, delete, rewrite or bypass canonical SurrealDB/EventLedger state
Foreground window creation, focus theft or unbounded diagnostic polling
acceptance_criteria: In the MT-401 REJECTED branch, this MT changes no product code and creates no UI. It validates MT-402..408 as NOT_APPLICABLE_BY_MT401_REJECTION and emits a redacted hsk.wp_local_store_rejection_projection@1 with authority hash, decision reference, exact no-change scan evidence and MT-410 handoff.
All remaining acceptance, UI, Argus and manual-update criteria apply only in the APPROVED_FOR_EVALUATION branch.

The versioned diagnostic schema always emits authority=LOCAL_NON_AUTHORITY, decision_posture=EVALUATION_NOT_ADOPTION, project_id, wp_id, lifecycle state, broker identity/generation, provider and schema version, encryption readiness, quota usage and last health timestamp.

Promotion diagnostics show counts and typed states for staged, running, canonical-committed-awaiting-readback, independently-verified, stale, rejected and local-only intents plus the last canonical receipt/watermark; local flags are never labeled canonical proof.

Recovery/archive diagnostics show quarantine, rebuild, seal, restore and retention states with correlation IDs, bounded progress and typed terminal results, without content, secret, key material or machine-absolute path disclosure.

The operator surface presents a persistent LOCAL NON-AUTHORITY badge and direct links to canonical SurrealDB receipt evidence; empty, healthy, degraded, quota-exceeded, corrupt, sealed and rejected-evaluation states are distinguishable by text as well as color.

Argus can reach stable semantic targets for store status, authority badge, promotion queue, recovery, archive and final evaluation verdict and can export a redacted structured snapshot plus reproduction steps.

Governed actions are limited to refresh, verify canonical receipt, retry eligible promotion, quarantine, rebuild disposable state, seal, restore read-only and preview retention; each action declares target, consequence and correlation ID and never mutates canonical data directly.

The built-in model manual explains purpose, conditional gate, startup/discovery, allowed inputs/outputs, navigation/API routes, authority boundary, common failures, recovery, archive and ADOPT/REJECT meaning for a model with no conversation history.
Automated diagnostics and Argus capture run quietly in the background, do not pop windows or steal focus, are rate bounded and expose cancellation/progress through Palmistry.
proof_targets: Contract-test every diagnostic state and assert LOCAL_NON_AUTHORITY plus exact redaction and canonical/local distinction.

Render the operator surface at supported sizes for empty, active, degraded, corrupt, sealed and rejected states and verify readability, discoverability, navigation, no overlap and visible important state.
Drive every stable target through Argus, capture structured state and screenshots, and reproduce one promotion mismatch and one corruption recovery without fragile coordinate selection.
Attempt cross-project access and secret/content/path injection into diagnostics and prove authorization-aware non-disclosure and redaction.
Give the updated manual and API schema to a no-context model and prove it can locate status, distinguish canonical truth and execute a safe recovery verification path.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Default and MT-401 rejection posture. The approved evaluation branch is governed exclusively by conditional_gui_obligation.

target_entries: WP-local working store > Purpose and authority boundary
WP-local working store > Status and diagnostics
WP-local working store > Promotion and canonical receipts
WP-local working store > Recovery, archive and retention
Model manual > Deterministic WP-local store routes and failure recovery

same_project_private_resource_cases: A same-project user without the exact WP/source grant sees neither local status nor canonical receipt metadata.
cross_account_negative_cases: Unauthorized diagnostic requests disclose neither another project/WP store nor receipt, archive or target existence.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Snapshots, screenshots, logs and Argus projections preserve the narrowest source scope and never expose record content.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Revocation or project/AccessSpace switch invalidates open views, cached snapshots and pending actions before refresh or mutation.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: Argus/model routes remain local product-control paths and never create remote Turso/SaaS/MCP storage access.
metadata_side_channel_cases: All snapshots, screenshots, logs, exports and errors redact content, credentials, key material, sensitive filenames, paths and denied existence.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: The panel projects attributable derived lifecycle and action events with canonical receipt links; Flight Recorder is never the authority proof.
The versioned redacted snapshot is the primary state, health and failure-isolation contract for humans, Argus and models.
Refresh, verification, retry, rebuild, seal, restore and retention jobs expose quiet bounded progress, cancellation and terminal result.

risk_if_missed: Operators and models can mistake local candidates for canonical truth, run unsafe recovery actions, miss degraded promotion state, or expose project data through diagnostics.

risks: A green health badge is read as proof that local data is canonical.
A diagnostic error leaks another project's resource existence or absolute database path.
A repair button bypasses independent canonical readback or deletes canonical data.
Argus depends on visual coordinates and silently operates the wrong WP.
minimum_controls: Persistent text authority label and direct canonical receipt distinction.
Closed typed action allowlist with target/consequence preview.
Stable semantic targets carrying project/WP identity and correlation receipts.

official_sources.title: Turso Rust SDK reference
official_sources.finding: Provider health and configuration can be observed through the adapter, but raw SQL/provider controls should not be exposed as the product diagnostics contract.

official_sources.title: SurrealDB permissions and row-level security
official_sources.finding: Record-user permissions default to no table access unless explicitly granted, supporting scoped diagnostic receipt reads and non-disclosure tests.

official_sources.title: SurrealDB Rust SDK
official_sources.finding: Typed authenticated backend reads can supply canonical receipt and watermark links independently of the local provider.

research_provenance.selected_approach: A provider-neutral diagnostic schema feeds a clear non-authority operator panel, stable Argus targets and a no-context manual with quiet governed actions.
rejected_options: Provider-specific UI as the product contract
Health status presented as canonical proof
